comment: VP-9 event screen and VP-12 run end (D-960..D-966): the run tally's keys (the web's run.stats damageDealt/damageTaken/lastHit, tallied by the session because the configured run's own stats stay as the web's oracle holds them), the USS classes, the art names and the values of Screens/Core2EventScreen.cs and Screens/Core2RunEndScreen.cs. The UXML names (CEVENT_*, CEND_*) and the screen ids are in ui.json (UiNames, ScreenIds).

keySets.name: Core2TallyKeys
keySets.doc: Keys of the run tally a Core 2 save keeps beside the run (combat.js trackStats: run.stats.damageDealt, damageTaken, lastHit).

keySets.name: Core2TallyValues
keySets.doc: Values of the run tally (combat.js trackStats): the cause prefix of a proc, the causes that name a striker or none.

keySets.name: EventClasses
keySets.doc: USS classes of the Core 2 event screen (Screens/Core2Event.uss).

keySets.name: EventArt
keySets.doc: Art names (ui/art.json lookup 'scene') of the event's painting band.

keySets.name: RunEndClasses
keySets.doc: USS classes of the Core 2 run end screen (Screens/Core2RunEnd.uss).

keySets.name: RunEndArt
keySets.doc: Art names (ui/art.json lookup 'scene') of the run end's painting.

keySets.name: EndPlaceholders
keySets.doc: Placeholders of the run end's strings that the shared UiPlaceholders lack.

keySets.name: EventScreenValues
keySets.doc: Values of the event and run end screens: the width rungs of their doors.
